title: Sociocultural knowledge is needed for selection of shots in hate speech detection tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Using LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations) to extract top-contributing words for hate speech predictions, revealing an erroneous over-reliance on culturally specific target group names and slurs, and analyzing changes in language model embeddings (cosine similarity) before and after fine-tuning.
Analyzing model over-reliance on religious identity terms (e.g., 'Muslim', 'Juden') for hate speech classification using interpretability tools.
Evaluating the erroneous association between ethnic group denotations (e.g., 'Roma', 'Rohingyas', 'Kikuyu') and hate speech predictions using LIME.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Using a curated culturally-informed lexicon (HATELEXICON) to check if models disproportionately rely on terms related to sexuality or gender identity (e.g., 'homosexual', 'transsexual') to make extreme speech predictions.
